_comment: Public servers the gateway starts at boot (server/src/web/servers.ts). Each runs one match
process that never ends: continuous rounds, the next map of 'rotation' after every match (the
maps: qalat = Qalat Village, bazaar = Sarai Bazaar, oilcamp = Oil Camp), players dropping in and out, bots
keeping each side at 'fill'. preset: full (MR24) or short (MR12). pause_when_empty: stop at the next
round boundary while nobody plays (decision Q6 c); otherwise an empty server keeps running its bots
without building snapshots (Q6 a). SERVERS_FILE points at another file; an empty 'servers' list runs none.

servers.name: Oil Field #1 - Oil Camp / Village / Bazaar
